meta.title: FAVX
meta.description: A platform to share recommendations, experiences and moments.

landing.headline: Share recommendations, experiences and moments.
landing.sub: A place to keep what you recommend and help other people find what matters.

login.title: Sign in to FAVX
login.intro: We will email you a verification code. No password needed.

errors.otp_invalid: The code must be 6 to 10 digits.
errors.otp_failed: Invalid or expired code. Request a new one.
errors.send_failed: We could not send the code right now. Please try again shortly.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.username_format: Use 3 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, hyphen or underscore, starting with a letter or number.
errors.display_name_too_long: The display name can have at most 80 characters.
errors.bio_too_long: The bio can have at most 500 characters.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.social_invalid: Check your selected social links. Use the HTTPS profile URL on the matching network.
errors.avatar_invalid: Choose a valid JPG, PNG or WebP image up to 20 MB.
errors.avatar_unavailable: Photo uploads are temporarily unavailable. Please try later.
errors.avatar_failed: Could not save the photo. Please try again.
errors.avatar_display_failed: Your photo was saved but could not be displayed. Refresh the page. If it persists, contact support.
errors.post_length: Use up to 160 characters in the title and 10,000 in the text.
errors.post_rating: The rating must be 0 to 10, in 0.5 steps.
errors.post_tags: Use up to 20 tags of 30 characters, without < or >.
errors.post_links: Give each link a label and a valid HTTPS address. Remove empty links.
errors.post_required: Add a title and text before publishing.
errors.post_disclosure: Describe the commercial relationship before publishing sponsored content.
errors.post_profile_private: Make your profile public before publishing.
errors.post_conflict: This post changed in another tab. Copy your changes and refresh before continuing.
errors.post_save_failed: Could not save. Your changes are still on this screen. Check your connection and try again.

me.title: My account
me.creatorInactive: You have not activated your Creator profile yet.
me.creatorActive: Your Creator profile is active as @{username}.

activate.title: Activate Creator profile
activate.intro: Choose your profile username. It identifies you on FAVX.
activate.usernameHint: 3 to 30 characters: a-z, 0-9, hyphen and underscore.

profile.title: Edit profile
profile.usernameLocked: The username cannot be changed for now.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address may be wrong or the content is not available.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We could not complete this action. Please try again.

creator.checkFailed: Could not check right now. Please try again.
creator.socialHint: Select the networks to display and paste the full link to each profile.
creator.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 20 MB. Your photo will be cropped to a centered square.
creator.publicHint: When you save, your name, photo, bio and links become visible to any visitor.
creator.privateHint: Your profile is still private. Select publish and save before sharing.
creator.copyManually: Select the link above and copy it manually.
creator.emptyBody: This Creator has not published recommendations yet.
creator.setupIntro: Add your photo and links. Check the preview before publishing.

posts.intro: Share a discovery, an opinion or something worth recommending.
posts.requiredPublish: A title and text are required to publish.
posts.tagsHint: Separate with commas. Up to 20 tags of 30 characters.
posts.linksHint: Add useful destinations. Check coupon terms and validity at the destination.
posts.sponsoredToggle: This content has a sponsor or commercial relationship
posts.disclosureHint: E.g. paid partnership with the brand. This notice appears on the post.
posts.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
posts.previewHint: Only you can see drafts. Publishing requires your confirmation.
posts.reviewHint: Review the content below. Once confirmed, it will be visible on your public profile.
posts.hideConfirm: Hide this post from your public profile? You can publish it again.
posts.privateProfileHint: You can save drafts. Make your profile public to publish.
posts.listIntro: Create, review and share your recommendations.
posts.emptyBody: Create your first post. It starts as a private draft.
